description: Said in the evening, ideally between asr and maghrib. The two verses at the end are said after the sun has set.
author: Summarised from the works of Shaykh Abd al-Aziz al-Tarefe

items.note: Recited three times each with al-Ikhlas and al-Falaq before it, morning and evening.
Said after the sun has set, unlike the rest of the evening adhkar.
